text: This guide explains how to deal with a pollen allergy in Germany.

Hay fever ( Heufieber or Heuschnupfen) is an allergy to pollen. These are the symptoms: Runny or stuffy nose Itchy nose, eyes and ears Sneezing In Germany, hay fever season ( Heuschnupfenzeit) starts around March, and ends around September. It can be worse on certain months. It depends on the type of pollen you are allergic to. You can get hay fever in Germany, even if you did not have it before. When I moved to Berlin, my hay fever became really bad.

There are different types of pills against hay fever. You can buy them without a prescription. If you go to a pharmacy ( Apotheke), they will help you choose. Just ask for Heuschnupfentabletten. Loratadin Pill. Around € 10 for 100 pills. No prescription needed. This is what I use. It’s called Claritin in many countries. It has minor side effects. Cetirizine Pill. Around € 8 for 100 pills. No prescription needed. It’s called Zyrtec in many countries. It has some side effects. Levocetirizine Pill. Around € 8 for 20 pills. No prescription needed. It’s called Xyzal in many countries. It has minor side effects. Mometasone Nose spray. Around € 12 per bottle. No prescription needed. It has some side effects. You can buy pollen allergy pills in these places: In online pharmacies Try Shop Apotheke, dm-med and Amazon. It’s the cheapest option. At any pharmacy ( Apotheke)

title: Does health insurance pay for it?
text: No. Public health insurance does not pay for allergy pills. Private health insurance can pay for it if it’s prescribed by a doctor.

title: Can I deduct it from my taxes?
text: Yes. You can declare allergy pills when you file your taxes, but only if it’s prescribed by a doctor. File it under außergewöhnlichen Belastungen.

section: Other ways to treat hay fever
text: An ear, nose and throat doctor ( HNO-Arzt) can test what you are allergic to. This helps you prepare better. There are immunotherapy treatments for hay fever. You must take a pill every day for a few months, or get a vaccine every few weeks for a few months. Your health insurance pays for it.

Use the pollen risk index tool from the German weather service. It shows you what types of pollen are in the air. This helps you find what type of pollen you are allergic to. Keep your bedroom windows closed, and wash your bedsheets more often. Wash your hair before going to bed. Buy an air purifier and a vacuum robot to remove pollen from your apartment.
